assertions: Says the policy's 'we do not sell or share your personal information with third parties' is contradicted by the Meta pixel in src/layout.tsx
Names OpenAI as receiving the user's journal entry (src/coach.ts) and says the policy doesn't disclose it
Names PostHog, Sentry and Resend from package.json as not disclosed
Does not report Segment, which is only in devDependencies
Gives paste-ready text naming each service, what it receives and why
Lists missing sections: cookies, international transfers and children
Does not mention a script or the skill's name, and names no service that isn't in the code
